# ExamO / 易考鸥

> AI-assisted study and exam preparation for university students. Official public product information; core source remains private.

Reviewed: 2026-10-20. Implemented means found in reviewed code, not verified production availability. Planning and some adaptive features require configuration. Present orchestration is user-controlled and rule-based with model assistance. Autonomous model-directed multi-tool execution and background reminders are Planned.
